Over the past six years, one brand has reshaped how Nigerians perceive, wear, and collect fine fragrances: Seinde Signature. Founded in 2020 by fragrance connoisseur Olaseinde Olufemi Olusola, Seinde Signature has evolved from a passionate curator of niche perfumes into an unquestioned powerhouse in West Africa’s luxury fragrance ecosystem. Today, it stands not merely as a retail outlet, but as a cultural sanctuary for scent enthusiasts, introducing discerning noses to artistic, rare, and ultra-luxurious notes from around the world. As the brand celebrates its 6th “Scentiversary,” Seinde Signature is proving that the art of smelling good is indeed serious business, and one that deserves to be rewarded in grand, life-changing style. Moving Beyond Bottles: A Golden Gratitude to Nigeria In previous years, celebrating a milestone at Seinde Signature meant exclusive perfume giveaways, intimate sniffing sessions, and curated gift boxes for loyal patrons. However, hitting the six-year mark called for a statement as bold and memorable as the extrait de parfums on their shelves. This time around, Seinde Signature is raising the bar by shifting from gifting exquisite bottles to handing over car keys. To mark this 6th Scentiversary, the brand is rolling out a massive appreciation campaign that features a brand-new, eye-watering N50 million grand prize vehicle, alongside a trove of high-end consolation prizes including the latest iPhones, luxury accessories, and rare collector fragrances. The philosophy behind this lavish gesture is simple yet profound: it is a heartfelt “thank you” to Nigerians for choosing to smell exceptional. “Six years of exquisite fragrances and an incredible community of scent lovers deserve a celebration that reflects that same level of luxury,” the brand revealed. “Smelling good is a lifestyle, an art, and a confidence booster. We want to show our community that investing in your personal scent profile can literally put you in the driver’s seat of a brand-new car.” How to Join the Scentiversary Celebration Running from October 25 to November 30, 2026, the anniversary reward scheme offers fragrance lovers, collectors, and gift-shoppers an unprecedented opportunity to turn their passion for fine perfume into a high-octane win. To participate, customers who spend N1 million or more on luxury and niche perfumes across Seinde Signature stores or official channels will automatically receive a raffle ticket, locking in their chance to win the N50 million luxury car or walk away with one of the coveted consolation prizes. Whether you are building your personal fragrance library with rich Ouds and rare ambers, stocking up on holiday gifts, or hunting down that elusive artisanal scent, every purchase during this window brings you one step closer to an unforgettable victory. Six years, hundreds of iconic scents, and one defining moment, Seinde Signature is proving that when you elevate your scent game, the universe rewards you in style. Ifeoma Okeke-Korieocha Ifeoma Okeke-Korieocha is the Aviation Correspondent at BusinessDay Media Limited, publishers of BusinessDay Newspapers. She is also the Deputy Editor, BusinessDay Weekender Magazine, the Saturday Weekend edition of BusinessDay. She holds a BSC in Mass Communication from the prestigious University of Nigeria, Nsukka and a Masters degree in Marketing at the University of Lagos. As the lead writer on the aviation desk, Ifeoma is responsible and in charge of the three weekly aviation and travel pages in BusinessDay and BDSunday. She also overseas and edits all pages of BusinessDay Saturday Weekender. She has written various investigative, features and news stories in aviation and business related issues and has been severally nominated for award in the category of Aviation Writer of the Year by the Nigeria Media Nite-Out awards; one of the Nigeria’s most prestigious media awards ceremonies. Ifeoma is a one-time winner of the prestigious Nigeria Media Merit Award under the 'Aviation Writer of the Year' Category. She is the 2025 Eloy Award winner under the Print Media Journalist category. She has undergone several journalism trainings by various prestigious organisations. Ifeoma is also a fellow of the Female Reporters Leadership Fellowship of the Wole Soyinka Centre for Investigative Journalism.
